title: Welcome to our Class Portal 🎓
body:
Assalam-o-Alaikum everyone!

We've made a website just for our 5th Semester class. Now you can access everything in one place:

• 📢 Notices and announcements
• ⚠️ Important warnings
• 🎓 All subjects and their lecture notes (PDFs)
• 📅 Weekly class schedule with timings

You can view notes online or download the PDFs directly to your phone.

Bookmark the site on your phone. We'll post all updates here from now on.

Stay tuned!
